02 · About

A bit about me.

Lahore, 2026

WordPress Developer · Designer.

I'm Faris Aziz, a WordPress developer based in Lahore, Pakistan. I have 1.5 years of professional experience designing, developing, and maintaining responsive websites. I currently work at NXP Technologies, where I've been a WordPress Developer since June 2025.

My toolkit includes Elementor Pro, WooCommerce, and ACF, alongside HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap. I customize themes, refine page layouts, and focus on speed optimization, website security, and basic on-page SEO.

I build scalable, user-friendly websites for local businesses, working closely with development teams and clients to turn requirements into practical web solutions. My training also includes Python, from basics to advanced concepts.
